spec.situation_desc: has a card payment they don't recognise

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Thistle Bank, Zara speaking. How can I help?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Hi, I’m Aoife Rahman. There’s a card payment I don’t recognise, and honestly I’m fed up with how difficult it is to get help from the bank.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’m sorry this has been frustrating, Aoife. I’ll look into the payment with you. First, could you tell me your full date of birth and the first line of your address?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thank you. And can you confirm your full name, please?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thanks, that’s all verified. Which payment are you concerned about?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: It’s £86.40 to Northstar Media on the 22nd of October. I’ve never used them.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I can see the payment you mean. I understand why you’re unhappy, especially after having trouble getting help. I can explain how to query it.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: What happens now? I don’t want to be passed around again.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’ll take ownership of this. I’ll send the payment details to our card team today, and I’ll call you by 3 pm tomorrow to tell you what the next update is. Someone may be in touch about the review, but I can’t give you a timescale for that.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: So you’ll call me tomorrow, but you can’t say when the review itself will be finished?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: That’s right. I’ll call by 3 pm tomorrow with an update, but I can’t promise an outcome or when the review will finish.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: All right. I just want to know someone’s actually dealing with it.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I will send it to the card team today and make that call tomorrow. Just to check, have I made the follow-up and the uncertainty around the review clear? Does that make sense?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thanks, Aoife. I’m sorry again this has been such a frustrating experience. Is there anything else I can help with today?
